record_stage.description: Which stage's non-pass record this counsel invocation read -- "spec" is a refused spec-gate record, read only when no build or verify record exists yet.

record.description: The stem (e.g. "build-01" or "spec-01") of the non-pass record counsel read.

reports.description: Field names adapters/<name>/conformance.json declares this adapter can supply with a real value (vendor independence, 2026-09-09 ruling) -- [] when no adapter was called or it declares no conformance.json.

status.description: "failed" when the adapter exited non-zero or returned no usable structured answer; class, verdict, citations, and proposal are then null/empty.

class.description: The stop's class as counsel itself reads it -- independent of, and possibly disagreeing with, the stop.class the counseled record already carries.

verdict.description: "answer": the stop is answerable inside the rules. "patch": the stop is a product defect. "person": the answer would touch the definition of done and no rule covers it.

citations.description: instruction, mechanism, guard -- each a path and symbol or a ruling id.

proposal.description: The ruling text (verdict "answer"), the patch or the issue (verdict "patch"), or the one-line question or the issue (verdict "person") -- exactly one of the four populated, matching verdict. issue is the remedy filed as an item rather than shipped as a diff or asked as a bare question (issue #175).

issue.description: A title and a body in this repository's own issue format (a Severity/Provenance line, then Problem, Retires, Change, and Acceptance sections) -- the shape attavo file-stops already files a stop as.

forge.description: counsel's own read of the forge on the counseled record's sha (issue #175) -- independent of, and read fresh from, whatever the counseled record's own forge_checks (verify only) already carries.

read.description: false only for missing manifest configuration or a counseled record with no sha -- never silently treated as a green forge.

reason.description: Set, naming the missing key, exactly when read is false; null when read is true.

checks.description: One entry per check [forge].checks_command reported on the counseled sha -- [] both when read is false and when a real read found no checks at all.

question.description: The operator's own text from `attavo counsel N --ask "<text>"` -- null for the ordinary stop path.
